description: Ex-VNAF Hercules displayed on the old Ta Con (Khe Sanh) airstrip, marked 532. Compiled listings expand this to 5-0532 and derive an ex-USAF 56-0476 identity; that chain is not corroborated, so only the displayed marking is recorded.
museum_name: Ta Con Airfield Historic Site (Khe Sanh Combat Base)

description: Transport aircraft moved to Ta Con from Dong Nai in early 2026 after a 4 billion VND restoration funded by Ho Chi Minh City; reported as the only substantially complete C-119 left in Vietnam. Newest arrival on the site.
museum_name: Ta Con Airfield Historic Site (Khe Sanh Combat Base)

description: Chinook displayed in the open on the former combat base; heavily corroded. A visitor report reads the number 025.
